title: Strings, Names and Text
introduction: Unreal provides different text types for manipulation, identifiers and player-facing localisation.
learningOutcomes: Choose between FString, FName and FText.
Create an FString with an Unreal string literal.
Format a simple value for logging or display.

activities.question: Which Unreal type is intended for localised player-facing text?
activities.explanation: FText carries information needed by Unreal's text localisation system and is the normal choice for player-facing text.

activities.question: Which type is a good choice for a frequently compared, case-insensitive identifier?
activities.explanation: FName is designed for efficient name storage and comparison and is commonly used for identifiers.
